event.title: Renowned Japanese Artist Yayoi Kusama Passes Away at 97
event.canonical_title: Renowned Japanese Artist Yayoi Kusama Passes Away at 97
event.summary: Yayoi Kusama, the celebrated Japanese artist known for her iconic polka dot designs and immersive installations, has died at the age of 97. Her passing occurred on August 14, 2026, in a Tokyo hospital, as confirmed by her company. Kusama's work, which spanned several decades, has left a significant impact on contemporary art, attracting global audiences and prompting widespread tributes.

timeline.title: Renowned Japanese Artist Yayoi Kusama Passes Away at 97
timeline.summary: Yayoi Kusama, a groundbreaking Japanese artist known for her distinctive polka dot motifs and immersive installations, has passed at the age of 97 in Tokyo. Her innovative contributions to contemporary art, characterized by themes of self-obliteration, have left a lasting impact on the art world.
